errors.text_span: The AttentionInfluence chart is divided into 15 slices
errors.evidence: The chart is a two-level sunburst chart with inner and outer rings, not a simple pie chart with 15 slices. This misrepresents the hierarchical structure of the data.

The description incorrectly identifies the numerical labels as percentages (%). The image shows whole numbers which represent counts, as correctly stated later in the description ('provide the exact count'). This error is repeated for all listed values.
The slice for "History & Society" in the AttentionInfluence chart is colored orange, not red. The red slice corresponds to "Science".
